page.overview:
Who is Ann?

Ann is a Candy Person who runs the Candy Drugstore. She was introduced in "Candy Streets." She has a tendency to ramble when she talks. She also pays lots of attention to the details that people say with a very powerful memory capable of remembering even the smallest bit of details that are mentioned.

She looks like a pink ice cream scoop on top of a darker pink ice cream scoop on top on an ice cream cone. She wears a name tag on the left side of her chest which says "Ann."
